lines.text: The root is Tract! Attract, distract, extract.
Did you know? Tract is Latin for pull.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus pull?

words.ex: The festival attracts thousands of visitors every year.
Loud music in the office distracts people from their work.
This oil is extracted from coconuts.

publish.title: Tract root: attract, distract and extract
publish.value: Tract comes from Latin "trahere" (to pull, to drag). Words: attract, distract and extract. attract = at + tract; distract = dis + tract; extract = ex + tract.
